full-access.title: Full control
full-access.body: The plugin's code runs directly in the app window without a sandbox. It can read and change all data and UI in the app, reach any website, and use the clipboard and files. After removing it, restart the app to stop it completely.

network.title: Network access
network.body: Can send your configuration, inputs and results to external servers.

clipboard-read.title: Read clipboard
clipboard-read.body: Can read anything you have copied.

plugins.consent_body: Plugins run in an isolated sandbox by default, without network or clipboard access. The permissions below lift those limits. Only allow them if you trust where the plugin came from.
plugins.consent_acknowledge: I understand the risk and trust this plugin's author
plugins.inactive_permissions: Not enabled: it needs your permission for {{permissions}}. Its features, tools and panels are unavailable until then.
plugins.load_title_one: This config comes with a plugin
plugins.load_body: Plugins are code written by someone else. Once loaded they run in an isolated sandbox, and plugins that ask for permissions such as network access ask again. If you are unsure where the config came from, don't load them: the config still works and the plugins stay in it, so you can load them later from the plugin list in the Config tab.
plugins.export_unreadable: The exported config could not be opened again, probably because a plugin wrote invalid data: {{reason}}
plugins.consent_combined: Other plugins in this config also have permissions: {{plugins}}. Plugins can pass information to each other through features they both take over or data shared in the app, so consider their permissions together before allowing.
plugins.wizard_carried: This config carries {{count}} plugins. They are kept as-is on export and do not run on the configuration page
plugins.wizard_carried_one: This config carries a plugin. It is kept as-is on export and does not run on the configuration page
